answers.text: Three lines, same order, every time — drop-off time, pallet count, damage noted. If nothing's noted, I'd write 'none' rather than skip it.
List each call by time, customer, topic and outcome, then count the follow-ups. If a customer calls twice about the same issue, I'd count it once.
The finish time doesn't add up — six hours from an 8am start shouldn't spill into the next day. Worth checking.
96 to 118 is more than a 20% rise. The on-time rate might need checking too.
Output 2 — shows 940 and 827 behind the 88%. Output 1 could be right too, but there's nothing to check it against.
Email 2, real numbers. Email 1 doesn't say what it's comparing to.
